links.outcome: 30-day readmission in randomized low-risk patients targeted by causal ML score, intervention vs usual care
links.effect: 30-day readmissions 7.7% vs 8.2% in intervention vs usual care, not statistically significant; observed-to-expected readmission ratio decline was statistically significant.
links.quote: While 30-day readmissions declined in the intervention group (7.7% vs. 8.2%), the difference was not statistically significant.

unlisted_practices: Using a causal machine learning predicted-benefit score to target care coordination to lower-risk patients

screen.reason: Large-scale randomized pragmatic deployment study evaluating the clinical and operational impact of an intervention targeted by a causal machine learning model (Predicted Benefit Intervention score), without evaluating a specific deployment practice or safeguard variation.
